s: Hello and welcome to Word Kitchen, the show where we cook up new English words and make them easy to remember.
Today we're taking a walk through city life.
We have ten new words about cities and daily life, and we'll use each one again and again so it really sticks.
Let's start with the word park.
A park is a green open area in a city, a place where people walk, run, and play.
Every morning I take a walk in the park near my apartment.
The park is always busy before work, full of people with their dogs.
And on Sundays, families have picnics in the park.
Children play football in the park after school, and older people sit on benches and read.
A neighbor is a person who lives near you, in the next house or the next apartment.
My neighbor waters my plants when I am away.
When we moved to our new street, our neighbor brought us a cake.
A kind neighbor can make a new place feel like home.
A market is a place where people buy and sell things, usually food.
I love the market near my apartment.
Oh yes, that market is wonderful.
We buy fresh fruit at the market every Sunday.
The market is always full of color and life.
You can buy bread, cheese, and fish at the market for less money than in a big store.
I go to the market twice a week.
A street is a road in a city or town.
We live on the same street, Maya.
Our street is quiet and friendly.
In the morning, the street is busy with cars and buses.
At night, the street is calm again.
Every street has its own feeling.
The main street downtown is full of shops and crowds.
I love walking down our street in the evening when it is quiet.
A hospital is a big building where doctors help sick people.
There is a hospital at the end of our street.
She went to the hospital because she had a fever.
The hospital in our city is very modern and clean.
I once visited a friend in the hospital.
The hospital staff were so kind.
I hope none of us needs the hospital often, but it is good to know it is there.
An apartment is a set of rooms in a building where a person or a family lives.
I live in a small apartment.
They rent a small apartment near the park.
My apartment is on the third floor, and I can see the street from my window.
Many people in big cities live in apartments.
My neighbor lives in the apartment below mine.
An apartment can be small, but it can still feel like home.
A crowd is a large group of people together.
A big crowd waited for the bus at the station this morning.
The crowd was so big that the bus was full.
I do not like big crowds in the morning.
Sometimes a crowd is fun, though.
At the market, there is always a crowd of shoppers.
And the crowd at the cinema on Friday night is full of energy.
A cinema is a place where people watch movies.
We watched a funny movie at the cinema last night.
I love going to the cinema with friends on weekends.
The new cinema near the park is very nice.
They show old films at the cinema every Tuesday.
A night at the cinema is the perfect end to a busy day.
Quiet means not loud, calm and peaceful.
Our street is quiet at night.
The library is a quiet place to study.
When the park is quiet, it is the best time for a walk.
After a noisy day at the market, I come home to my quiet apartment and relax.
A quiet evening is all I need.
Our last word today is visit.
To visit means to go and see a person or a place.
We will visit my aunt this weekend.
I want to visit the new cinema with you.
And I plan to visit the hospital this week to see my friend.
Let's also visit the market together on Sunday.
We can visit all our favorite spots in the city.
Park, neighbor, market, street, hospital, apartment, crowd, cinema, quiet, visit.
Ten new words about city life.
Use them in your daily life.
Take a walk in the park.
Buy fresh food at the market.
And visit us again tomorrow on Word Kitchen.
